contract: one font file read from memory; every face of a collection, each with HarfBuzz's OpenType font functions at its default scale (units per em) and in triergon-shape with OtMetrics at units per em
per glyph of every face, in order: whether hb_font_get_glyph_extents gives extents, and its x bearing, y bearing, width and height (zero when it gives none); packets count glyphs
a face the candidate cannot open and a glyph whose extents it cannot read within the face's limits are recorded as such, so the case fails; the file is read before each timed and memory operation
